title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal UI Icons…
description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal UI Icons allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects UI Icons versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.1.3, from 2.0.0 to 2.0.2.
